looks.name: Brown Overshirt
looks.alt: Man in a dark brown overshirt, white T-shirt, light grey trousers and white trainers
looks.line: A dark brown overshirt worn open over a white tee. Relaxed, tidy, made for a beer garden.

looks.name: Rust Cable Knit
looks.alt: Man in a rust cable-knit jumper and blue jeans
looks.line: One good jumper does all the work. Cosy enough for a country pub with a fire.

looks.name: Stone Shirt
looks.alt: Man at a bar in a stone-coloured shirt and light jeans
looks.line: A stone-coloured shirt worn loose over light jeans. Easy and clean, fits any local.

looks.name: Flat Cap & Tweed
looks.alt: Man in a flat cap, tweed jacket and waistcoat, grey trousers and brown boots
looks.line: Tweed, a waistcoat and a flat cap. Full country pub, if you are brave enough.

looks.name: Chambray Overshirt
looks.alt: Smiling man in a grey chambray overshirt holding a pint
looks.line: A washed chambray shirt worn open over a tee. Relaxed enough for a long session.

looks.name: Charcoal Shacket
looks.alt: Man in a charcoal shirt-jacket, dark jeans and black trainers
looks.line: Charcoal shacket, dark jeans, black trainers. Low effort, still looks sorted.

name: Wedding
blurb: Guest, not groom. Sharp, not showy.

looks.name: Bright Blue Three-Piece
looks.alt: Man in a bright blue three-piece suit with a white shirt and buttonhole flower
looks.line: A blue three-piece with a white shirt and pale tie. Stands out without upstaging the groom.

looks.name: Grey Check Three-Piece
looks.alt: Man in a grey check three-piece suit and brown brogues on stone steps
looks.line: Grey check, brown tie, brown brogues. The classic British wedding guest.

looks.name: Navy, No Tie
looks.alt: Man in a navy suit and open white shirt
looks.line: Navy suit, crisp white shirt, no tie. Made for a relaxed reception.

looks.name: Charcoal & Red Tie
looks.alt: Man in a charcoal check suit with a red tie
looks.line: A charcoal check suit lifted with a red tie. Traditional, with a flash of colour.

looks.name: Navy Suit & Trainers
looks.alt: Man in a navy suit and striped tie with white trainers on a lawn
looks.line: Sharp navy suit and striped tie, finished with clean white trainers. The modern wedding.

looks.name: Beach Wedding Blazer
looks.alt: Man in a navy blazer and open white shirt with a buttonhole flower by the sea
looks.line: Navy blazer, open white shirt, flower in the lapel. Made for a wedding by the sea.

name: Job interview
blurb: Look hired before you say a word.

looks.name: The Dark Suit
looks.alt: Man in a black suit, white shirt and tie
looks.line: Dark suit, white shirt, simple tie. For banks, law and anywhere formal.

looks.name: Blazer & Jeans
looks.alt: Man in a grey blazer, open white shirt and blue jeans
looks.line: Grey blazer, open-collar white shirt, good jeans. For start-ups and creative roles.

looks.name: Navy & Pocket Square
looks.alt: Man in a navy suit, open white shirt and white pocket square
looks.line: Navy suit, open collar, white pocket square. Confident but approachable.

looks.name: Tweed & Knit Tie
looks.alt: Man in a grey tweed blazer, white shirt and black knitted tie
looks.line: Grey tweed blazer, white shirt, slim black knit tie. Smart, with personality.

looks.name: Navy Suit & Tie
looks.alt: Man in a navy suit, white shirt and dark tie
looks.line: The classic: navy suit, white shirt, dark tie. Never the wrong answer.

looks.name: Shirt & Tie, No Jacket
looks.alt: Man in a light blue check shirt, tie and black trousers
looks.line: Check shirt, tie, smart trousers. For warm days or less formal firms.

name: Casual weekend
blurb: Coffee, errands, a walk in the park.

looks.name: Double Denim
looks.alt: Man in a denim shirt-jacket, white T-shirt, ripped jeans and a beanie
looks.line: A denim shirt-jacket over a white tee. The easiest weekend uniform there is.

looks.name: White Tee & Jeans
looks.alt: Man in a white T-shirt, light jeans and trainers, jacket in hand
looks.line: Plain white tee, light jeans, trainers. Nothing to think about, always works.

looks.alt: Man in a black leather jacket, yellow T-shirt, jeans and tan boots
looks.line: A pop of yellow under black leather. A weekend with a bit of attitude.

looks.name: Cable Knit & Beanie

looks.name: Grey Tee, Black Jeans
looks.alt: Man in a grey T-shirt, black jeans and black trainers
looks.line: Grey tee, black jeans, black trainers. Simple and city-ready.

looks.name: Check Overshirt
looks.alt: Man in a grey check overshirt and blue jeans
looks.line: A soft check overshirt with good jeans. Smart enough for brunch.

name: First date
blurb: Effort, but not too much effort.

looks.name: Camel Coat

looks.name: Rust Check Blazer

looks.name: Roll-Neck & Blazer

looks.name: Shirt & Trousers
